summary: PowerShell script is excellent: strong error handling, proper exit codes, follows conventions (Set-StrictMode, -ErrorActionPreference). Workflow is structurally sound (pwsh shell, minimal permissions, job dependency). However, deliverable is incomplete: missing actionlint validation (explicitly required by task), missing act test harness with fixture parameterization and act-result.txt capture (explicitly required), workflow assumes tests/SecretRotationValidator.Tests.ps1 and fixtures/secrets.json exist without validation. Cannot run end-to-end without these pieces.
